comments.author: beastrev
comments.body_html:
Hey takenmake,

Love the mod. Makes the game 100x more playable. Just wanted to report an incompatibility though.

This mod seems to conflict with Amend’s Hitmarkers mod. Killfeed and fatal shot still work, but normal hit markers are broken for some reason!

comments.author: takenmake
comments.body_html:
Glad you like the mod!

Thanks also for letting me know about the compatability thing, I haven’t played with that mod before so I didn’t know. I’m looking into making it more compatible with other mods in a future update, which will hopefully come sooner rather than later since I’ve discovered some issues of my own when running it on 3.5.7.

For those who care: I also have found that it’s incompatible with Viceral Dismemberment, which I am aware of and hope to fix.

comments.author: beastrev
comments.body_html:
Great to hear!

As I said, fantastic mod and it genuinely deserves a place in every load order and some compatibility fixes would ensure that
